answer: Each challenge is instantiated from a threshold-BLS drand quicknet pulse revealed only after the participant commits, binding the task and response to an unpredictable, publicly verifiable round. A swarm cannot precompute reusable answers or farm them offline; commits, one-use proofs, and per-identity resource limits constrain parallel retries. The vault, crystal, and plume labels serve only as domain-separated inputs, not secret entropy.
